descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'White Peaches' Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'White Peaches' is more white strand of 'Peaches and Cream' found at Dr. Bump's garden by Talon Buchholz. Some believe this may have been a sport mutation on 'Peaches and Cream' with more white that nurserymen grafted unknowingly. The white reticulated foliage has a peach to purple border in the early spring.The green veins become prominent mid-to-late spring. Fall color on 'White Peaches' may range from yellow to orange. I would expect 'White Peaches' to reach 6-8ft in 10 years. The photo(s) with a MrMaple logo are owned by MrMaple.com and cannot be used without expressed written consent. The photos on this page without a MrMaple logo were taken by Talon Buchholz and cannot be used without expressed written consent from the owner.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'White Peaches' 网斑锦日本枫，适生分区 5-9。'White Peaches' 可视为 'Peaches and Cream' 的一个更偏白的类型，由 Talon Buchholz 在 Dr. Bump 的花园中发现。有人认为这可能是 'Peaches and Cream' 上一个更白化的芽变，后来被苗圃在不知情的情况下通过嫁接繁殖开来。其白色网斑叶在早春带有桃色至紫色边缘；至春末，绿色叶脉会变得更加明显。'White Peaches' 的秋叶颜色可由黄色转为橙色。预计 10 年可达 6-8 英尺高。带有 MrMaple 标志的照片归 MrMaple.com 所有，未经明确书面许可不得使用。本页未带 MrMaple 标志的照片由 Talon Buchholz 拍摄，未经所有者明确书面许可不得使用。数量有限。由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，单个品种通常库存不多；部分选育品种常会很快售罄，建议尽早购买心仪品种。
